meta.note: STATIC half of the Logic-Studio association. A live /api/log line is matched to a row by its 'match' regex -> source file:line + CWE. An output change with no matching WRITE/FORCE row is the provenance gap that reveals an unaudited (memory-corruption) write.

gloss.plain: A device answered a discovery/identify request on bacnet.
gloss.eng: A read/enumeration/handshake -- no output changed, but the device disclosed identity or state.
gloss.cyber: Reconnaissance surface. No write, but it maps the device for an attacker (ATT&CK for ICS discovery).

gloss.plain: A write was refused before it could change anything.
gloss.eng: The guard (mode gate / protocol arbiter / ACL) rejected the command; the process image did not change.
gloss.cyber: This is the control working. The refusal is the weakness that WOULD exist without the gate -- the log proves the gate fired.
